req.title: Task creation persists
req.statement: The system shall commit new task rows so subsequent GET calls return them across requests.

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to verify the persistence of task creation in the task management system. It includes a positive test to ensure successful task creation, a negative test to handle invalid input, and a boundary test to check the system's behavior at the edge of valid input values.

tests.name: test_create_task_success
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to create a new task with valid data.
expected: The response payload matches the created task data.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

new_task = {
    "title": "Test Task",
    "description": "This is a test task.",
    "completed": False
}

response = client.post("/tasks/", json=new_task)
assert response.status_code == 201
response_data = response.json()
assert response_data["title"] == new_task["title"]
assert response_data["description"] == new_task["description"]
assert response_data["completed"] == new_task["completed"]

tests.name: test_create_task_invalid_data
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to create a new task with invalid data (missing title).
expected: The response contains validation error details.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

invalid_task = {
    "description": "This task has no title.",
    "completed": False
}

response = client.post("/tasks/", json=invalid_task)
assert response.status_code == 422
assert "detail" in response.json()

tests.name: test_create_task_boundary_title_length
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to create a new task with a title of maximum allowed length (100 characters).
expected: The response payload matches the created task data.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

boundary_task = {
    "title": "T" * 100,
    "description": "Boundary test for title length.",
    "completed": False
}

response = client.post("/tasks/", json=boundary_task)
assert response.status_code == 201
response_data = response.json()
assert response_data["title"] == boundary_task["title"]
assert response_data["description"] == boundary_task["description"]
assert response_data["completed"] == boundary_task["completed"]
